newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine retail firm plans share offer.
newsitem.headline: Philippine retail firm plans share offer.

text.p: WGI Gaisano Group Inc, owner of several shopping malls in the central and southern Philippines, is planning to offer 880 million shares to the public at one peso per share, a draft prospectus submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission showed.

Gaisano has tapped Peregrine Capital Philippines to be the issue manager and domestic lead underwriter and Furman Selz LLC as the global coordinator and international lead manager, the prospectus said.
The company plans to used the proceeds to partially fund the construction of three new malls, one of which will be built in Manila.
